repos_data.description: AI code security scanner MCP server — detects invisible Unicode, Trojan Source, homoglyphs, Glassworm steganography, rules file backdoors, and dependency attacks in AI-generated code. Static analysis + CodeBERT deep learning. Runs locally.
Inkog MCP Server — the pre-flight check for AI agents
🤖 AI code quality gate for AI-generated code. Detects hallucinated packages, phantom dependencies, stale APIs, and more. MCP Server + CLI + CI/CD Action.
The go-to web for your AI coding agent — local-first search, fetch, crawl & research over MCP. No API keys, no cloud, $0/query. Public beta.
Local-first MCP server that gives coding agents structured context packets, code/schema facts, and diagnostics - backed by a local SQLite store.

Local guardrails for AI coding agents. Wraps any MCP server and blocks destructive tool calls — DROP TABLE, rm -rf, force-push, unscoped UPDATE/DELETE — before they execute. Free, open-source, runs entirely on your machine.
Security scanner and introspection tool for MCP servers. Connect, inspect, detect injection patterns, find tool shadowing, baseline for drift. Single binary, zero dependencies, Go stdlib only.
Whole-repo code intelligence for AI agents over MCP — hosted server docs (idencify.com)

Security infrastructure your AI can't be — deterministic, daily CVE intel past your model's training cutoff, whole-repo-aware, author-independent, and shift-left: secure_prompt secures the prompt before code generation. The security MCP for vibe coding: 450 rules, 39 tools, CLI + doctor for Next.js, Supabase, Clerk, Stripe, Prisma, Hono & MCP.

Open source local-first PR scanner that finds dead code, security bugs, secrets, quality regressions, and AI-code mistakes before merge. For first timers refer to https://duriantaco.github.io/skylos/repo-map/
Tentra MCP — memory for AI coding agents. Persistent code graph + AI architecture diagrams. 32 MCP tools. Works in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf.
